ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota Immigration Enforcement
ideas.description: Investigate the alleged fraud in Minnesota immigration enforcement and track the flow of funds
questions: What is the extent of the alleged fraud in Minnesota immigration enforcement?
How has the Trump administration responded to the allegations?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and shed light on the Trump administration's priorities. By following the money, we can track the flow of funds and determine the extent of the alleged fraud.
